summary: The gateway service experienced high error rates because upstream requests to the orders service failed. The orders service suffered from excessive memory usage and OOMKilled restarts following the deployment of version 1.4.0.

leads: Check `http_server_requests_seconds_count{outcome="SERVER_ERROR"}` to see which endpoints are failing on orders (runbook:triage-high-error-rate)
Check gateway logs for "upstream request failed" (502) or "upstream request timed out" (504) to identify which upstream dependency is causing errors (runbook:gateway-upstream)
Examine outgoing call latency from gateway to orders since orders is experiencing a 20% failure rate in traces (runbook:triage-high-latency)
triage.query: HighErrorRate gateway gateway: 17.68% of requests are failing; HighLatency inventory inventory: p95 latency is 1.856s

related.text:
- An alert like "orders: p95 latency is 2.3s".
- Callers' outgoing call latency (`http_client_requests_seconds`) rises together
  with the callee's server latency.
- Once latency passes a caller's timeout it turns into errors: the gateway
  returns 504 "upstream request timed out", and HikariCP logs "Connection is not
  available, request timed out after 2000ms".
related.title: HighLatency: p95 above one second

related.text:
- An alert like "orders: 12% of requests are failing".
- `http_server_requests_seconds_count{outcome="SERVER_ERROR"}` rising for one or
  more services.
- Callers log failed calls. The gateway logs "upstream request failed" (502) or
  "upstream request timed out" (504).
related.title: HighErrorRate: a service is returning 5xx

related.text:
- HighErrorRate on gateway. The gateway logs "upstream request timed out" (504,
  with `timeout_ms`) or "upstream request failed" (502).
- 504s: the upstream is slow, or the timeout is too short for its normal
  latency.
- 502s: the upstream is down or refuses connections (crash loop, rollout, pods
  not ready).
related.title: Gateway 502 and 504 responses

triage.summary: Gateway is experiencing a critical high error rate affecting users and orders.

alerts.name: PodCrashLooping
alerts.summary: payments: container restarted 2.253 times in 10 minutes

alerts.name: PodCrashLooping
alerts.summary: orders: container restarted 2.008 times in 10 minutes

hypotheses.summary: Version 1.4.0 of the orders service introduced excessive memory consumption / a memory leak, causing pods to be OOMKilled. This rendered orders unavailable or unresponsive, causing upstream timeouts and high error rates at the gateway.

evidence.shows: orders service exceeded its container memory limit and experienced OOMKilled restarts
Version 1.4.0 introduced new code for stacked discount codes that caused excessive memory usage
Orders pods are terminating due to out-of-memory (OOM) kills
Gateway requests to orders are timing out and failing because orders pods are crashing/unreachable

hypotheses.suggested_fix: Investigate memory consumption in orders version 1.4.0, increase memory limits if necessary or fix the memory leak, and ensure pods stabilize.

review.reason: Version 1.4.0 was rolled back to 1.3.0 at 07:12:28Z, prior to the incident at 08:20:13Z, so it cannot be the root cause of the current error rate.
